body:
Running official Repo2RLEnv generation and validating exports currently requires experiment-specific launchers. Add `biotasks generate` for pinned source acquisition, frozen official PR discovery, upstream bootstrap/generation, local export and independent native controls; `biotasks validate` also accepts existing exports. Manifests and journals bind source/inputs/SDK/payloads, reserve cumulative CPU/model budgets, reconcile provider costs, verify eligible archives and clean owned resources. Interrupted or scientifically inconsistent output is retained explicitly.

The limited supported profile preserves the pinned official bootstrap/model calls, tests, parser and reward. Defaults retain the original new-test-function filter; the existing upstream boolean option and an explicit pytest argument policy are available as declared choices. There is no added author/solver/model-repair loop. Compiled rebuilding, native import-provenance instrumentation and the subtest-parser gap remain unresolved and are excluded.

For mixed-case repository caches and lowercase Docker tags, resolve one matching identity and normalize only disposable staging for the unchanged upstream inline exporter. Preserve raw/cache and grading bytes, rejecting collisions, symlinks and image/ref/repository mismatches. An explicit completed mode imports only known producer profiles with all seven verified stages, immutable lineage, readbacks, complete billing and settled reservations; it cannot drive an old run. Normal resume still requires exact code identity. This lets a local connector update reuse a sealed export without another bootstrap or model call.

Validation: **186 tests**, including distribution/install and CLI invocation outside the checkout, plus Ruff lint/format, ty and hooks. Both GitHub CI checks pass at c19e7369. Actual pinned-API fixtures reproduce the cache failure and candidate success; a clean installed package verifies the original sealed generation with network, credential reads and file writes forbidden, rejects old-run execution, and prepares/replays its export byte-inertly. [Evidence and limits](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/6544dcd596eae5f6ba088fa8b178fd9d916dd602/experiments/65-sealed-case-safe-export/results.md). [Independent native controls #65](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/issues/65) completed against the existing #62 export under the unchanged validation profile: nop 0 / oracle 1, target 0/1 → 1/1, all 1,145 tracked P2P tests passing on both sides. Four untracked failures persist and oracle exits 1, so strict clean-command eligibility is false. Both HF readbacks, owned cleanup and completed installed replay are verified. The same clean installed candidate also completed a fresh NiBabel workflow automatically, including all four generation/control archive readbacks and owned cleanup: nop 0/oracle 1, target 0/9 → 9/9, all 37 P2P tests pass on both sides, oracle exit 0. The original raw/cache/grading assets are unchanged, and completed installed CLI replay is byte-inert with transport and credential reads forbidden. [Fresh end-to-end evidence](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/0d7344963b050bf3743de14d4d6858039c2c6201/experiments/66-fresh-nibabel/results.md). That clean result covers the selected test-file command; no population yield or production/release readiness claim.

This fresh main-based branch copies the qualified implementation without merging research history, consolidating #46, #50, #52 and #55 plus the declared integrations. Earlier PRs remain open; keep this draft for review. Related epic: #33.
